title: Scout Recovery Handoff Receiver Observation v1
description: A browser adapter's independently collected identity for comparing a signed recovery handoff. The consuming host must authenticate the observation source; this document alone does not make its claims trusted.
$comment: The receiver observation establishes browser context only. Application outcome must be graded separately using an authoritative application-side oracle.

owner_scope.description: Authenticated host principal or tenant scope.

browser_generation.description: Host or broker token mapped to the live browser context.

target_id.description: Target independently observed by the receiving browser adapter.

frame_id.description: Selected frame identity. Empty denotes the top-level frame only when frame_binding_known is true.

frame_binding_known.description: True only when the receiver has positively identified the selected frame; false prevents a context match.

policy_id.description: Effective policy identifier supplied by the trusted host or browser broker.
